title: Cases of flu-like illnesses rise by 31% in two weeks – DOH
summary: MANILA, Philippines – Cases of influenza-like illnesses (ILI) nationwide increased by 31 percent over two weeks, according to the Department of Health (DOH). The DOH recorded 15,042 cases from Oct. 1…
